replies.author: JKawesome
replies.body:
Just make a void world, and copy your map into it using MCedit or something.

Regarding your second question, get a plugin called VoidGenerator, then the command to create a void world will be /mv create [world name] NORMAL -g VoidGenerator

replies.author: Zintenka
replies.body:
The map is poorly done with not a lot of customization put into it; but that's expected for a first time map.

Ways to make void:

  • MCEdit (Recommended, if you've already created the world and have prior knowledge on how to use this program.)
  • Custom world options for superflat. type 0 (highly un-recommended)
  • WorldPainter (Recommended, starts MB from 90MB)
  • Ask Alex to join his build server and do the coomand JKawesome told you. (Recommended)
